brief:
The UN Office of Human Rights in the Occupied Palestinian Territory said no place or person is safe in Gaza nearly a year after a ceasefire was announced, according to Shehab Wire. The assessment underscores the continuing volatility across the territory despite the formal end to hostilities.

The office documented that 24 Palestinians, including four children, have been killed in recent incidents. The figures reflect the persistent dangers faced by civilians in the enclave since the ceasefire took effect.
